about: Add-ons Settings > Add-ons can download. Built into Bloom.dll. Each is a separate program from its own GitHub repository (repo, owner/name): Bloom reads bloom-addon.json from that repository's latest release ({id, version, zip, sha256, size, minBloom}), downloads the zip it names from the same release, and installs it only when the zip matches that sha256 and size and its addon.json has this id, that version and that minBloom. A release is taken only when its version is later than the one Bloom has and not before minVersion (so an older release can't be served in place of the newest), and only when this Bloom is at least its minBloom. name and about ({"ko": …, "en": …, "ja": …, "zh": …}) are what its line on that page shows, before and after it is downloaded; the taskbar add-on (pill-taskbar) has its own line and needs neither. The release workflow reads every entry's latest release the same way and refuses to release while one has no valid bloom-addon.json.
